_doc: Curated copy for the brain UI. Live counts (journals, workouts, entities, syntheses) come from the wiki. This file holds the synthesis prose. Strings may use {placeholders} - see brain-data.server.ts for the variables available per hub.

ideas.headline: Replace this headline with a synthesis of your active ideas.
ideas.summary: Replace this paragraph with a 2–4 sentence synthesis across your idea pages - what's hot, what's stalled, what connects.

threads.label: Hot idea
threads.text: What's most active right now and why.

threads.label: Stalled
threads.text: What's paused and what would unblock it.

threads.label: Connection
threads.text: A non-obvious link between two ideas.

journal.headline: Replace this with a synthesis of recent journal arcs.
journal.summary: What dominant questions show up across your recent journals? Where is your gut leading vs. your reasoning?

threads.label: Recurring theme
threads.text: A phrase or worry that's repeated this week.

threads.label: Signal
threads.text: A small thing that pointed at a bigger thing.

health.headline: Replace this with a synthesis of your training arc.
health.summary: What did your last meaningful event reveal? What's the unsolved problem in your training?

threads.label: Anomaly
threads.text: Anything off from bloodwork or recovery.

people.headline: Replace this with a synthesis of who's in your orbit right now.
people.summary: Who is decision-shaping this week? Who is in your daily orbit? Who is new?

threads.label: Decision-shaping
threads.text: Whose read is load-bearing right now.

travel.headline: Replace this with a synthesis of meaningful travel.
travel.summary: Which trips changed the questions you ask? Which were geography? What's next?

threads.label: Recent
threads.text: A more recent trip and what it surfaced.

health.headline: Replace this headline in data/brain-content.json.
health.summary: Replace this paragraph in data/brain-content.json - a 2–3 sentence synthesis of where your training is right now and what's unsolved.
health.chartFootnote: What pattern does your HR chart show?
health.zoneFootnote: Source synthesis page: link or describe.

connections.note: Edit in data/brain-content.json - what does training reveal about how you are?
Who shows up in the gym / on long runs / in recovery?
Does your training data inform any of your ideas?
